column1: # model_type -> launch scripts, for CI.
# Columns (single-space separated, no spaces inside a column):
#   1. model_type   exact name passed to @register_model(...) in
#                   src/torchturbo/models/<dir>/model.py
#   2. run_dir      directory under scripts/runs that holds its launch scripts;
#                   "-" when no CI launcher exists yet
#   3. lf_launchers    comma-separated llama-factory scripts, first one is the
#                      default; "-" when unsupported
#   4. swift_launchers same for ms-swift
#   5. hf_repo      the HuggingFace repo CI downloads when no explicit model path
#                   is given; "-" when unknown, which makes the train workflow
#                   refuse to run without train_model_path
#   6. e2e          PR 端到端画像：
#                     full    = 全量权重（train_layers=0）
#                     trim:N  = 只留前 N 层（flash_trim → model.py trim），train_layers=N
#                     -       = 不参与 PR 端到端
#                   「族内小模型优先」：已经有 tiny/2B 版的不再减层；
#                   只有 35B 这种跑不动的才减层，否则一次 PR 要几十分钟。
# Keep this file in sync with the registry; the train workflow fails if a
# registered model_type is missing here, so drift shows up on the next run.
# model_type            run_dir           lf_launchers                          swift_launchers                       hf_repo                       e2e
